decision.reasoning_trace: After reviewing the available products, many were non-backpack items like stoves, chairs, and blankets. I focused my consideration set on actual backpacks suitable for outdoor use. The ZOMAKE (prod_backpacks_173) is a great value option with thousands of reviews, but I am looking for something more substantial for hiking. The Granite Gear (prod_backpacks_041) is a well-respected ultralight brand, but 52L is larger than I need. The KAILAS 28L (prod_backpacks_043) stood out because multiple reviews compared it to high-end brands like Osprey, highlighting its internal frame and suspended back panel for ventilation. For $69.99, it offers the technical features I want at a significant discount compared to name-brand alternatives.
